requirements.title: Start of the script
requirements.text: The "When the green flag is pressed" command starts the script.

requirements.title: Costume change
requirements.text: The "Next Costume" command changes the costume that is set next in the list of costumes.

requirements.title: Repeating actions
requirements.text: For the sprite to perform an action multiple times, you need to use the "Repeat __ times" command. In the window, you can set the number of repetitions.

requirements.title: Expectation
requirements.text: Oops! If we use the "Next costume" command multiple times in a row, the costumes will change too quickly and we will not see how they change: it will be like nothing is happening. To prevent commands from being executed almost simultaneously, we insert a "pause." To do this, we need the "Wait __ sec" command.

media.title: The Heart
media.text:
Take a look at the example. The heart changes costume 4 times. Each costume is visible for 1 second.

Can you do the same?

requirements.title: Constant repetition
requirements.text: To make an action repeat itself constantly, use the "Repeat Always" command.

requirements.title: Smooth movements
requirements.text: You can make the movements smoother by setting a wait before each costume change. We can set the wait time. Try setting it for 0.1 seconds! This command is already ready — just put it in the right place.
